policies.title: Finnish ordinary passports: federal Iraq electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Finnish Foreign Ministry guidance requires an ordinary-passport tourist to hold an electronic visa before arrival in Iraq.
conditions: A tourist using an ordinary Finnish passport must obtain the electronic visa before arriving. The Finnish guidance directs applicants to Iraq's eVisa service and says the rule also covers travel solely to the Kurdistan Region.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Iraqi electronic visa service
steps: Apply for the electronic visitor visa before travel using the ordinary Finnish passport to be used for entry.
Carry the issued eVisa information and comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Finnish ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official ordinary-passport process gives a preapproval online and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: The online route is for a valid ordinary passport. Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.

At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the ordinary Finnish passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Côte d'Ivoire evisa, but its official ordinary-passport procedure requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
